sentence: Driven by a profound inner duality, Anacardium is engaged in a continuous struggle between goodness and cruelty, between weakness and power, oscillating between self-doubt, hardness, and fleeting confidence.
references: Herscu, P. ND DHANP. 'Anacardium Fundamental Segments: The Mental Sphere.' New England Journal of Homeopathy, Vol 5 #3.
Herscu, P. & Rothenberg, A. NESH curriculum materials.

segments.name: Weakness and self-doubt
segments.description: Profound sense of mental and physical weakness. Inability to make decisions, mind goes blank during exams or interviews. Lack of confidence, feels inferior. Memory weakness, especially for names and recent events.

segments.name: Dual nature — good versus evil
segments.description: Inner conflict between opposing forces. Feels as if possessed by two wills — one good, one evil. As if an angel on one shoulder and devil on the other. Religious conflict, moral struggle.

segments.name: Cruelty and hardness
segments.description: The suppressed weakness erupts as cruelty, malice, cursing. Wants to swear but restrains himself. Hardhearted, unsympathetic. May be verbally or physically abusive to the weak. Inclination to curse.

segments.name: Fleeting confidence and power
segments.description: Brief periods of feeling strong, powerful, in control. As if a switch is flipped and suddenly capable. But it is short-lived and crashes back into doubt. Moments of bravado.

segments.name: Anger at being misunderstood
segments.description: Fury that others do not see the internal struggle. Feels insulted, slighted, unappreciated. Hypersensitive to offense. Discontented with everything and everyone. Quarrelsome.
